SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D H 712
S.2, Sb. Box 7 section 103
Date April 2, 1933.

Subject (in full) Copy of a letter from the Kwang Hwa (光華) Book Co., Shanghai,
addressed to the International Literature, Moscow.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached copy of a letter from
the Kwang Hwa Book Co., Shanghai, addressed to the International
Literature, P.O. Box 850, Moscow, U.S.S.R., I have to report
that enquiries made by C.D.S.155 at the Bookstore Owners'
Association, No.3, Lane 340, Thibet Road, indicate that there
is only one bookstore by the name of Kwang Hwa (光華) and
is situated at 552 Foochow Road.

The record of this bookstore as known to the Police
is as follows :-

(1) Despatch from Shanghai Special District Court to the
Commissioner of Police dated 10.3.28 requesting that a
reactionary publication entitled "Van-Tseu-Pei-Khan"
(紅洲本刊) be suppressed.
Result: Book withdrawn from circulation; notice to this
effect appeared in "Shun Pao" on 11.3.28. Vide File I.O.8982.

(2) Despatch from Shanghai Provisional Court to the Commissioner
of Police dated 31.10.29 requesting that a reactionary
publication entitled "My Youth" (我之青年) be suppressed.
Result: Publication already stopped by the Educational
Bureau of the Shanghai Special Municipality. Vide File
D.659.

(3) Despatch from Shanghai Special District Court No.5534 to
the Commissioner of Police dated 2.3.31 re: extradition
of the criminal Yui Ziang Sung (余祥生); sealing of seven
bookstores including the Kwang Hwa; and prosecuting the
responsible persons therein. Vide File D.1939.

(4) Premises - 552 Foochow Road - visited by the Municipal
Police at 5.30 p.m. 19.1.31 on the authority of a warrant
issued at the request of the Soong-Wu Military Authorities

主题（全文） 上海光华书局致莫斯科国际文学社信函副本。

由警探顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）制作 转呈人 [签名]

关于附上的上海光华书局致苏联莫斯科邮政信箱850号国际文学社的信函副本，本人谨此报告，刑事侦缉处第155号警员在西藏路340弄3号书店业主公会进行的查询表明，名为“光华”的书店仅有一家，位于福州路552号。

警方掌握的该书店记录如下：

(1) 上海特区地方法院于1928年3月10日致警务处处长的公函，请求查禁一份名为《红洲本刊》（Van-Tseu-Pei-Khan）的反动刊物。
结果：书籍停止发行；相关公告于1928年3月11日刊登于《申报》。参见档案 I.O.8982。

(2) 上海临时法院于1929年10月31日致警务处处长的公函，请求查禁一份名为《我之青年》的反动刊物。
结果：该出版物已由上海特别市教育局勒令停刊。参见档案 D.659。

(3) 上海特区地方法院第5534号案件于1931年3月2日致警务处处长的公函，事由：引渡罪犯余祥生（Yui Ziang Sung）；查封包括光华书局在内的七家书店；并起诉其中的责任人。参见档案 D.1939。

(4) 地点 - 福州路552号 - 市政警察于1931年1月19日下午5时30分，凭宋吴军事当局申请签发的搜查令前往搜查反动文献。

COPY OF A LETTER FROM THE KWANG HWA (光華) BOOK CO.,
SHANGHAI, ADDRESSED TO THE INTERNATIONAL LITERATURE,
POST OFFICE BOX 850, MOSCOW, U.S.S.R.

Shanghai, March 7, 1933.

Editors, International Literature :

If you would know the greatness of our joy in receipt
of your letter, consider that of your own giantism.

The new international revolutionary cultural world
is come, and not to you alone. You are the beginning.
Your magazine "International Literature, " is the first,
the leading magazine.

To enter into correspondence with you and to arrange
an exchange of your magazine with ours are of immediate
benefit to us. We the masses of workers and toiling
intellectuals in China, feel sure that your magazine may
bring to us many things that we want.

At the same time that we take this letter to the
post, we take our magazine "文藝創作講座 " (Lectures
on New Literature) in two volumes.

On receipt of this letter, please send us your
magazine - from the first issue to the recent..

We wish to arrange this exchange for ever.

With best wishes,

Sincerely,

(Signed) 文藝創作講座
(Lectures on New
Literature)

上海光华书局致苏联莫斯科邮政信箱850号国际文学社信函副本。

上海，1933年3月7日。

《国际文学》编辑们：

若欲知晓我们收到贵方来信时的喜悦之巨大，请试想贵方自身之宏伟。

新的国际革命文化世界已经到来，且不仅仅属于你们。你们是开端。
贵刊《国际文学》是第一份，也是领先的杂志。

与贵方建立通信关系并安排贵我双方杂志互换，对我们有 immediate benefit（即时益处）。我们中国的广大工人和劳苦知识分子确信，贵刊能带给我们许多我们所渴望的事物。

在将此信寄出之际，我们也寄上两卷本我们的杂志《文艺创作讲座》（Lectures on New Literature）。

收到此信后，请寄给我们贵刊——从第一期至最近一期。

我们希望永远保持这种交换关系。

致以最美好的祝愿，

诚以此致，

（签名）文艺创作讲座
（Lectures on New
Literature）
